The Journey

Three cities.
Seven years.
One honest consultancy.

London, UK
2020 — Left everything behind

Intention without infrastructure. No financial plan, no support structure — just a feeling it was time.

Cairo, Egypt
2021 — Attempt one

The dream ran out before the money did. Back in months. Expensive lesson, no one to ask.

Hargeisa, Somaliland
2022 – 2024 — Closer, but not right

Better planning. Wrong destination. Two years learning the difference between moving toward an idea and building a life.

Madinah Al-Munawwarah
2024 — Home

This time it worked — because the move was planned, not felt. Al-Nomaad is the help I never had.

Present
Now — Still here. Helping others do the same.

Living in Madinah. Every client I work with saves years I lost finding the way alone.

Find Your Starting Point

Every hijrah starts
somewhere. Find yours.

Scroll to the stage that describes where you are right now — and see exactly what changes from there.

01
Stage One · Still Exploring

You feel the pull — but you still have more questions than answers.

Is Madinah actually right for your family? What does it genuinely cost to live there? Can your income travel? These aren't romantic questions — they're the ones that determine whether the move works or falls apart six months in. We answer them honestly, so you can decide with your eyes open.

Where we come in

A Discovery Call gives you straight answers on finances, lifestyle, and whether the timing is right for you — from someone based in Madinah with direct experience, not someone selling a dream from abroad.

02
Stage Two · Actively Planning

The decision is made. Now the gap between deciding and arriving needs to close.

Most hijrahs that fail don't fail at the decision — they fail in the gap. The wrong neighbourhood, the wrong property chosen remotely, the sequence done out of order. We close that gap on the ground, in person, before you arrive — so when you land, the hard work is already done.

Where we come in

The Madinah Roadmap maps your neighbourhood, scouts and inspects your property, negotiates your lease, and has everything in place before you board the flight. A Discovery Call scopes exactly what you need.

03
Stage Three · Ready to Move

You have a date. You need someone to make sure nothing falls through the cracks.

This is the full picture: a furnished flat set up before you land, someone at arrivals, SIM and utilities working from day one, Iqama facilitation through a trusted specialist, and six months of ongoing support after you're in. You arrive into a life — not into chaos.

Where we come in

The Full Landing is the complete A-to-Z handover. Nothing is left to figure out alone. Start with a Discovery Call to map the full picture together.

FAQ

Questions people actually ask.

Still have something specific? The Discovery Call is the fastest way to get a real answer.

01 Does the Discovery Call fee count toward a package?

Yes. If you go on to book any package or bundle priced over £150 — the Hijrah Compass, the Madinah Blueprint, the Full Landing, or either Property Bundle — your Discovery Call fee is credited in full. You pay for the call once, not twice.

02 Is this only for Madinah, or do you cover other cities?

Al-Nomaad is built specifically for Madinah — it is where the consultancy is based, and what makes on-ground services possible. Consultations can cover other cities for context, but property work and practical services are Madinah-specific.

03 I'm not sure which package is right for me.

Start with the Discovery Call. You will get an honest recommendation on which package — or individual service — fits your situation. If none of them are right yet, that will be said plainly. There is no pressure to commit to anything on the call.

04 What does the property inspection actually cover?

40+ checkpoints, photos included, written report delivered within 48 hours of the visit. The inspection covers structural condition, Haram proximity timed on foot, noise levels at different times of day, landlord assessment, and everything you need to make a confident decision from abroad.

05 I'm a sister planning to move. Is this set up for that?

Al-Nomaad works with sisters travelling with a mahram. Community connections include families and sisters already settled in Madinah. Safety is factored into every neighbourhood and property assessment — including building access, proximity to facilities, and neighbour profile.

06 Can I get Iqama help without taking Tier Three?

Iqama facilitation is included in Tier Three. The Iqama route can be discussed in any consultation — including the Discovery Call — so you understand the process and what it involves before committing to a package.
